facts.fact: The World Bank-led Joint Monitoring Report team's Joint Food Security Monitor for South Sudan raises monthly Typical, Heightened or Critical alerts for 78 admin-2 areas using a Drought - NDVI and a Drought - rainfall indicator group.
The World Bank-led JMR team states the South Sudan Joint Food Security Monitor datasets, including alerts, are compiled and updated monthly (version dated 2026-07-06).

systems.owner: World Bank Development Data Group, Joint Monitoring Report team
